description: This is a shell script used for building Debian packages within a software project. It installs necessary build dependencies, installs a package build dependencies using mk-build-deps, and builds specific packages in the project directory.

methods.name: install_debuild_dependencies
methods.description: Installs necessary dependencies for building Debian packages, including devscripts, config-package-dev, debhelper-compat, and equivs.

methods.name: build_package
methods.description: Builds a Debian package located in the specified directory by installing its dependencies with mk-build-deps and then invoking debuild.
